# Review - PR 294 @ 3338ec82c05dbbe3be70948e2e458a207467973c

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author,
fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref:
`0452668f95ec58b82dda222a66c6c8ef5b01c9d1` (github/main). Small main-relative change,
+416/-5 over four files from merge-base `5abb1eab02a9a5d6a83f69fe2b1556db7b335c22`:
a two-line docstring correction in the extraction observables, two new audit records,
and blueprint chapter 16 dependency and proof-environment updates for the
pulled-apart measurement and swap-unitary nodes.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope. Base is `main`, so the review is against `github/main`. Worktree HEAD and the
published PR head both read `3338ec82c05dbbe3be70948e2e458a207467973c`. Exact-head CI
is green: `local-ci/summary` success, with `build`, `blueprint-render`,
`blueprint-sync`, `file-length`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion` and `paper-gaps` all
passing and `statement-origin` correctly skipped.

Proof integrity. `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean` (603 lines) contains no
`sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` token at this head, and
`lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean` in the PR worktree
elaborates with rc=0 and no diagnostic output. `MIPStarRE/Quantum/ControlledUnitary.lean`,
which the new blueprint support node links to, is likewise hole-free. No theorem
statement, hypothesis list, or definition is touched by this diff: the only Lean edit
is inside a docstring.

Faithfulness of the swap identities. Compared the four swap declarations against the
source. Paper `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1689-1699`
gives V_A V_A-dagger = Id from projectivity of the polynomial-pair measurement and
self-inverse Pauli observables; `swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose` and
`conjTranspose_mul_swapUnitary` state exactly the two inverse identities under the
existing `w : GlobalPairWitness S delta`, using only `w.projective` and
`(w.Smeas side).sum_eq_one`. Lines 1701-1713 give the observable conjugation with the
crossed decoder arguments `tau^X(Dec(g_Z)) tau^Z(Dec(g_X))` and the twisted-commutation
phase; `swapUnitary_conj_tildeObs` keeps that order, both decoder crossings, and the
`V N V-dagger` orientation, and cancels the phase by squaring it (`phaseSign_mul_self`),
not by discarding it. Lines 1805-1822 give `eq:qld-unitary-6`; `swapUnitary_conj_tildeM`
concludes `I (x) bracketOp (pauliProj W) (fun h => lowDegreeEnc h u) a`, matching
`tau^W_{[g_h(u)=a]}`, with the initial fiber `Dec(g).ind_m(u) - a` of `eq:tilde_M`
(paper line 1432) and the characteristic-two cancellation `b - a + b = a`. Worth
recording: the paper's fifth line reindexes via `g_{h'} = g_h + g_W`, which presupposes
that the encoding of a decoded polynomial returns that polynomial - the identity this
repository documents as false in general. The Lean proof and the blueprint proof both
avoid it: the decoded dot product cancels outright, and the blueprint says so and cites
`rem:qld-decoding-identity`. The docstring edit at `Observables.lean:563-566` is what
makes this visible in the Lean source, replacing a declaration name used as mathematical
prose with the encoding identity on indicator vectors; the proof's final step still
calls `lowDegreeEnc_eq_dotProduct`, so the prose and the proof agree. No new hypothesis,
bridge, witness, wrapper, or error relaxation appears anywhere in the diff.

Blueprint and prose. `lem:tilde-m-projective` moves the two projectivity prerequisites
out of the statement `\uses` into a new proof environment, which is what the
`\uses` guideline in `docs/blueprint_style_guide.md` prescribes (statement lists what is
needed to state the result, proof lists what the proof calls); the new proof text is a
correct account of the orthogonal-sum and `Equiv.subLeft` reindexing arguments the Lean
proof performs. The new `lem:controlled-sum-support` node follows the
formalization-only-lemma convention of that guide precisely: the `[Formalization support
for ...]` title, a preceding sentence stating that it is not a named result of the source
article, a `\uses` edge from the proof that actually calls it, and a proof-level `\leanok`
backed by two complete Lean proofs. Its displayed hypotheses (projective measurement with
complete effects; per-outcome right-unitarity for the second assertion) match the
signatures of `sum_heteroKron_mul_sum_heteroKron` and `sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose`.
Every label cited by the new or extended `\uses` lists resolves to exactly one
`\label{...}` in `blueprint/src`. No `\leanok` in the diff claims a proof that is not
complete, and the downstream approximate extraction node `lem:qld-unitary` still carries
no proof-level `\leanok`.

Prior findings. Review 5197214550 at head `3a617b56` raised F1-F3 and review 5234584175
at head `e96cd92a` raised R1. F1 and F2 are visible in the chapter 16 diff (dependency
relocation, support node, richer swap-proof dependencies); F3 is the docstring edit
above. R1 asked for YAML front matter on `audits/2026-09-07_swap-extraction-121.md`;
commit `3338ec82` adds `title`, `date`, `purpose`, `issue` and `pr`, quoted as
`audits/2026-04-29_audit-document-format.md:25-45` requires. Nothing from either earlier
review is left open at this head.

One non-blocking observation, already noted by the earlier reviewer and not raised as a
finding here: the proof environment of `lem:v-swap-conjugation` now carries `\leanok`
twice, at `blueprint/src/chapter/ch16_qpbt_extraction.tex:479` and `:481`. The second is
redundant markup making the same true claim; rendering and blueprint sync both pass, so
it is not a merge blocker.

Not checked: no full `lake build`, no rendering run, no independent `#print axioms`
sweep, and no re-verification of the audits' historical validation narratives beyond the
present-state facts above - for those I relied on the exact-head CI statuses. The two
audits record dated construction history and are read as records, not as claims about
this head. Nothing in this PR bears on the existence of the global polynomial-pair
witness or on the approximate extraction conclusion of `lem:qld-unitary`, both of which
remain open elsewhere.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)
